title: Continuity of the Gram-determinant Jacobian √det(⟨DΦ(v)eᵢ, DΦ(v)eⱼ⟩) of a C¹ map
statement: Let Q, n ∈ ℕ and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ). Then the function v ↦ √det(⟨DΦ(v)eᵢ, DΦ(v)eⱼ⟩)_{i,j=1..n} is continuous on ℝⁿ. Here DΦ(v) = fderiv ℝ Φ v, eᵢ = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 are the standard basis vectors, ⟨·,·⟩ is the Euclidean inner product and √ is Real.sqrt.
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q), ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → Continuous (fun v : Eucl n => Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ v (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det)
